system_environment.device: Intel Core CPU (8 threads configured in Ollama runner)

architectural_observations.fast_path_acceleration: Tier 1 fast-path processes standard curriculum misconceptions in < 0.2ms, completely avoiding LLM latency.
architectural_observations.tier2_cost_tradeoff: Tier 2 CPU inference takes ~1016.7ms per unclassified proposition. The two-tier architecture protects system throughput by delegating only ambiguous and dictionary-uncovered cases to Tier 2.
architectural_observations.caching_efficiency: Static proposition hash caching eliminates redundant Ollama calls within the worker lifecycle, achieving sub-millisecond execution on repeated assertions.
